summary: 3 FULL endpoints and the sweeper fully conform. 1 FULL consumer (payment.completed) conforms. 4 consumers (payment.failed, payment.expired, order.cancelled, product.created) and 2 handlers (stock.adjust, stock.bulk-read) are STUB — 501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED_MVP per README; not findings.
